Rashi on Shabbat 56b:10:1.hebrew: מקיש ראשונים - מקיש את בנינו של שלמה לביעורו של יאשיהו: מה יאשיהו לא עשה ביעור זה, ותלו בו מן השמים לשבח, הואיל וביער השאר שנעשה משמת יהושפט — אף שלמה לא עשה בנין זה, ותלו בו לגנות, מתוך שלא מיחה בנשיו:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:10:1.english: [The verse] juxtaposes the earlier ones - [It] juxtaposes Solomon's building to Josiah's destruction: Just as Josiah did not carry out this destruction, yet Heaven attributed it to him for praise, since he destroyed the rest [of the idolatry] that was made after the death of Jehoshaphat — so too, Solomon did not carry out this building, yet [Scripture] attributed it to him for disgrace, because he did not protest against his wives.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:12:1.hebrew: שמש - לחטוב עצים ולשאוב מים בשכר לע"ז:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:12:1.english: A servant - To chop wood and draw water for hire for idolatry.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:12:2.english: And not have this matter written about him - To teach you that rebuke is severe against one who has the power to protest [and does not]:

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:14:1.hebrew: נעץ קנה - ושרטון מדבק בו, עד שנוסף והולך וגדל. שרטון — חול ורפש וטיט שהים גורש:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:14:1.english: Implanted a reed - And a sandbar adhered to it, until it continually accumulated and grew. A sandbar [is] sand, mire, and mud that the sea casts up.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:14:2.hebrew: כרך גדול של רומי - שהוא מיצר לישראל, והוא (איטליא) של יון במסכת מגילה (דף ו:):
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:14:2.english: The great city of Rome - Which causes distress to Israel, and it is [the] "(Italia) of Greece" in Tractate Megillah (daf 6b).

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:15:1.hebrew: ביום שהעמיד ירבעם את העגלים נבנה צריף אחד - באותו שרטון שגדל שם בימי שלמה. צריף — כוך קטן מציידין, שעושין מן קנים ומן ערבה; ומאז נתוספו בתים על בתים:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:15:1.english: On the day that Jeroboam set up the calves, a single hut was built - [It was built] on that sandbar that grew there in the days of Solomon. A hut [tzrif] — a small shelter of hunters, which they make from reeds and from willow; and from that time on, houses were added upon houses.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:15:2.hebrew: איטליאה - שם העיר, והיא ממדינת יון. וכשנטלה רומי מלכות יוונים, לכדוהו ונהפך להם:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:15:2.english: Italy - [This is] the name of the city, and it is [part] of the land of Greece. And when Rome took over the kingdom of the Greeks, they captured it, and it turned over to them.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:16:1.hebrew: יאשיהו חטא - דכתיב "שב אל ה'", משמע דחטא מעיקרא:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:16:1.english: Josiah sinned - For it is written, “[who] returned to the Lord,” implying that he had sinned initially.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:17:1.hebrew: מבן ח' - שישב על כסא מלכותו, דכתיב: "בן ח' שנה וגו'":
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:17:1.english: From [the age of] eight - When he sat upon the throne of his kingdom, as it is written: "Josiah was eight years old [when he began to reign]..." (II Kings 22:1).

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:17:2.hebrew: עד בן י"ח - שמצא חלקיה את הספר, ועיין ודקדק בתורה ובדיניה — בכתב ובעל פה — והבין שמא טעה בדינא:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:17:2.english: Until the age of eighteen - When Hilkiah found the [Torah] scroll, and [Josiah] examined and scrutinized the Torah and its laws — both written and oral — and realized that perhaps he had erred in judgment.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:17:3.hebrew: נטל מזה - ממי שנתן לו תחילה. ה"ג: ״ואמרי לה אחא אחוה דאבא אבוה דרב ירמיה בר אבא״:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:17:3.english: He took from this one - From the one to whom he initially gave [it]. This is the correct reading: “And some say, Aḥa, the brother of Abba, the father of Rav Yirmeya bar Abba.”

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:19:1.hebrew: נתן דצוציתא - על שם ניצוצין דנורא, שהמלאך פשט את ידו וקיבל תשובתו. לישנא אחרינא: על שאחזו המלאך בציצית ראשו:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:19:1.english: Natan Detzutzita - [Named] on account of sparks of fire, when the angel stretched out his hand and accepted his repentance. Another version: Because the angel seized him by the lock of hair on his head.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:2:1.hebrew: על עסקי נחל - ומה על נפש אחת אמרה תורה: הבא עגלה ערופה בנחל, נפשות הללו — על אחת כמה וכמה! אם גדולים חטאו, קטנים מה חטאו:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:2:1.english: With regard to matters of the valley - And if regarding a single life the Torah said: Bring a heifer whose neck is broken in a valley, [then for] these lives, all the more so! If adults sinned, what did the children sin?

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:4:1.hebrew: ולא עבדו ישראל עבודה זרה - שעל ידי שנחלקה המלכות, העמיד ירבעם העגלים, שלא יעלו ישראל לירושלים לממשלתו של רחבעם:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:4:1.english: And Israel would not have worshipped idols - For because the kingdom was divided, Jeroboam set up the [golden] calves, so that Israel would not go up to Jerusalem, to the realm of Rehoboam.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:5:1.english: Solomon sinned - In [the sin of] idol worship.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:6:1.hebrew: כדר' נתן - דשני קרא: הטו ללכת, והוא לא הלך:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:6:1.english: In accordance with Rabbi Natan - For he resolved the verse: [His wives] turned [his heart] to go, but he did not go.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:8:1.english: Here too, he built [it] - This is a difficulty.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:9:1.hebrew: אלא - מהכא תילף דלא בנה, כדתניא: רבי יוסי אומר כו':
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:9:1.english: Rather - From here you derive that he did not build [them], as it was taught: Rabbi Yosei says, etc.

Rashi on Shabbat 56b:9:2.hebrew: להר המשחה - לשון שמן, דמתרגמינן משחא, והוא הר הזיתים:
Rashi on Shabbat 56b:9:2.english: To the Mount of Anointing - An expression of oil, as we translate [oil into Aramaic as] mishḥa; and it is the Mount of Olives.

Tosafot on Shabbat 56b:10:1.hebrew: מה אחרונים לא עשו ותלה בהן כו' - לא שייך למימר הכא: "מקום הניחו לו אבותיו להתגדר בו", כדאמר בפ"ק דחולין (דף. ושם:) גבי נחש נחשת שביער חזקיה — דהתם לא ביערוהו אבותיו, שהיו יראים לבערו לפי שעשאו משה על פי הדבור; אבל הכא, למה היו מניחים מלבערם?:
Tosafot on Shabbat 56b:10:1.english: "Just as the later ones did not do [it], and [the verse] attributed [it] to them, etc." - It is not applicable to say here: "His ancestors left him room to distinguish himself," as [the Gemara] says in the first chapter of Chullin (6b and there) regarding the copper serpent that Hezekiah destroyed — for there, his ancestors did not destroy it because they were afraid to destroy it, since Moses had made it by Divine command; but here, why would they refrain from destroying them?

Tosafot on Shabbat 56b:19:1.hebrew: דצוציתא - אומר ר"ת, דאמר במדרש שהיה נר דולק על ראשו:
Tosafot on Shabbat 56b:19:1.english: Detzutzita - Rabbeinu Tam says that it states in the Midrash that a lamp burned upon his head.

Tosafot on Shabbat 56b:8:1.hebrew: אלא מעתה אז יבנה יהושע כו' - הקשה הר"ר אלחנן: דבחלק (סנהדדין דף צא:) מפקינן, מדכתיב "אז יבנה יהושע" ולא כתב "אז בנה", מכאן לתחיית המתים מן התורה; אם כן אתא לדרשה — ה"נ אתא לדרשה דהכא! ואומר ר"י: דמ"מ פריך, מדלא כתיב "שבקש לבנות" אלא "יבנה", ש"מ שרוצה לומר שבנה — כההוא דיהושע, דודאי בנה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 56b:8:1.english: “If so: ‘Then did Joshua build...’” - Harav R. Elchanan raised a difficulty: For in [Perek] Chelek (Sanhedrin 91b), we derive from that which is written, “Then did Joshua build [yivneh],” and it is not written, “Then did Joshua build [banah],” [that] from here [is a source for] the resurrection of the dead from the Torah. If so, [there the verse] comes for an exposition; here too, it should come for an exposition! And the Ri says that nevertheless, [the Gemara] objects: Since it is not written, “that he sought to build,” but rather “will build,” learn from this that it means to say that he [actually] built — just like that [case] of Joshua, who certainly built.
